column1: # Adjudication log: every disagreement between ablaut and a gold source is
# ruled on here, with a reference. The golden harness treats a mismatch with
# ruling "ours" or "both" as adjudicated-correct and reports it separately.
# Rulings: ours = gold is wrong, ablaut's form is the standard one.
#          both = both forms are standard; gold lists only a variant.

column4: note

du hießest / du hießt both standard; UniMorph lists only hießt
du ließest / du ließt both standard; UniMorph lists only ließt

wachen takes haben (ich habe gewacht, Duden); kaikki/Wiktionary lists sein
entgelten is strong (entgalt, entgolten, Duden); gold gives weak entgeltete forms
Strong waschen base (wusch rein, reingewaschen); gold lists weak waschte forms only
Conjugates like geben (begibst weg, wegbegeben); gold lists weak begebst/wegbegebt forms
zu umfassen is correct for the inseparable sense; gold lists only umzufassen
zu übergehen is correct for the inseparable sense (skip); gold lists only überzugehen
liegengelassen and liegenlassen (Ersatzinfinitiv-style) are both standard; gold lists only the short form
kahlscheren builds on scheren (schert kahl, kahlgeschoren); gold derives it from a verb schieren
Imperative gegencheck! follows the fused paradigm; gold splits only here, inconsistently with its own finite forms
